capabilities: Capture multi-page photos from a phone via a QR-code web page over the same WiFi
Convert images to structured Markdown with LaTeX formulas using a vision LLM
Insert results at the current cursor position or save them as new notes
Rotate, crop, and adjust brightness or contrast of photos before upload
Insert photos directly as embedded attachments without LLM recognition
extras: Recognition mode requires an API key, but the direct image-insertion mode works without one; the README notes the plugin is not yet listed in the community market ('after listing') and warns against running its local HTTP server on untrusted networks.
problem: Getting printed text, math formulas, and tables from paper into Obsidian Markdown normally means manual retyping or juggling separate OCR and screenshot tools.
